brief: Client: type 4 basement; same rules + design; dark design with wood accents (spa, sauna, WC) and plants after 3 refs; no windows -> beautiful lighting everywhere; sectional garage door; smaller Mercedes than a G-Wagon; furniture less boxy; 100% plan-accurate.
lessons: dark guides give weak geometry -> spa guides rendered at exposure 2.4 (the look comes from the prompt / reference, not the guide brightness)
ultra-wide 96-102 deg lenses: the model elongates the room -> 86-90 deg
a previous render used as the look reference carries its (wrong) geometry into every retry -> geometry retries use mood refs / text only
white spheres still read as lamps -> orchid as stems; decor kept out of camera foregrounds
